title: Mass controls evaluation: mass-null sequences tend weakly to 0, mass-summable series converge weakly, and the mass of the weak sum is at most the sum of the masses
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, and let X_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (j ∈ ℕ). (i) If M(X_j) → 0 in [0, ∞], then X_j(ω) → 0 in ℝ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U). (ii) If Σ_j M(X_j) < ∞ (tsum in [0, ∞]), then (a) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) the real series Σ_j X_j(ω) is summable, and (b) every Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) such that Σ_j X_j(ω) = Y(ω) (HasSum) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) satisfies M(Y) ≤ Σ_j M(X_j). Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)); for U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^n(U) = TestFormOn U n (smooth n-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_n(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U n (SimonGMT Chapter06), X(ω) the value of X on ω. |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector. M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (such ω are admissible for M_G, massAdmissibleOn U n G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). HasSum is unconditional summation in ℝ; Σ_j M(X_j) is the tsum in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n), (Tendsto (fun j => (X j).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Tendsto (fun j => X j ω) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∑' j, (X j).mass < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Summable (fun j => X j ω)) ∧ ∀ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun j => X j ω) (Y ω)) → Y.mass ≤ ∑' j, (X j).mass)
